payload.text: hv, 2026-10-15: `infra --profile` takes a path, and devbin builds no name form (hv chose A: close it, paths only). A name such as `--profile <name>`, looked up as profiles/<name>/infra.yaml, would only save typing for the one project that keeps a profile per estate (Prodinfra), which works today by path or by DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE; a project that wants a shortcut keeps its own. This closes the request dc first raised on 2026-09-07 (vc's hold 4) and Prodinfra's open item on it, and it is not put to hv again.
